title: Province
description: A state or province code, based on ISO 3166-2 definitions.

province_code.description: State or province code, as defined in ISO 3166-2. For example, US-CA, CN-11, GB-CAM, and so on.

local_name.description: Local province name. For example, California, Northern Ireland, 東京都, 北京, Москва́, and so on.

latin_name.description: Optional Latin or international province name, if local name is in non-Latin script. For example, 'Tokyo' for the local name '東京都', or 'Beijing' for '北京', or 'Moscow' for 'Москва́'.

abbreviation.description: Abbreviation, if required. For example, `CA` for California.
